description: Stand up the vLLM PD-disaggregated 4P4D topology on the B300 via NIXL: a prefill instance on GPUs 0-3 (TP4, kv_producer) and a decode instance on GPUs 4-7 (TP4, kv_consumer), fronted by the disagg proxy on port 30080. Reuse the exact NVFP4/fp8-KV/DSpark flags from the TP8 run. Troubleshoot live over SSM until proxy /health is 200 and a smoke chat completion succeeds end to end. LIVE-INSTANCE ops over SSM only.
steps: Depends on FEAT-001 (all 8 GPUs free). All work via SSM send-command; background long-running server launches with nohup + logfile + tail-poll (they exceed send-command timeout). Consider a single driver script written to /opt/dlami/nvme/pd/launch_pd.sh on the instance (write via a heredoc inside the SSM command, or cat > file) so relaunches are one command.

PREFILL instance (kv_producer) on GPUs 0-3: docker run -d --name vllm-prefill --network host --ipc host --shm-size 32g --gpus all -v /opt/dlami/nvme:/opt/dlami/nvme -v hfcache:/root/.cache/huggingface -e VLLM_USE_V1=1 -e HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 -e NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3 -e VLLM_NIXL_SIDE_CHANNEL_PORT=5600 -e UCX_TLS=cuda_ipc,cuda_copy,tcp vllm/vllm-openai:nightly --model /opt/dlami/nvme/models/nvidia__DeepSeek-V4-Flash-nvfp4-DSpark --served-model-name dsv4-nvfp4-dspark --tensor-parallel-size 4 --enable-expert-parallel --trust-remote-code --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 --max-model-len 133120 --reasoning-parser deepseek_v4 --tool-call-parser deepseek_v4 --enable-auto-tool-choice --speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","num_speculative_tokens":7,"draft_sample_method":"greedy"}' --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8100 --kv-transfer-config '{"kv_connector":"NixlConnector","kv_role":"kv_producer"}'

DECODE instance (kv_consumer) on GPUs 4-7: identical to prefill EXCEPT -e NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=4,5,6,7, -e VLLM_NIXL_SIDE_CHANNEL_PORT=5601 (must differ from prefill's 5600), --name vllm-decode, --port 8200, and --kv-transfer-config '{"kv_connector":"NixlConnector","kv_role":"kv_consumer"}'. Keep DSpark speculative-config + fp8 KV + NVFP4 on the decode side (this is where TPOT/ITL matters).

Watch BOTH containers come up in parallel by tailing logs: docker logs -f vllm-prefill and docker logs -f vllm-decode (poll via repeated SSM 'docker logs --tail 80 <name>'). Cold start is multi-minute (weight load ~50s + DeepGEMM/cicc kernel compile + FlashInfer autotune). Green signals to confirm on each: 'DSpark draft model loaded' , kv cache block size set for the fp8/DEEPSEEK layout, TRT-LLM fused MoE / UE8M0 DeepGEMM, NixlConnector init lines (side-channel bind on 5600 / 5601), and finally 'Application startup complete' + Uvicorn bound on 8100 / 8200.

Health-gate each engine: curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8100/health and :8200/health must each return 200, and nvidia-smi must show gpumem>0 on GPUs 0-3 (prefill) and 4-7 (decode). A 200 with 0 MiB is a dead shell - treat as failure.

Start the proxy on 30080 (reuse the image's model-agnostic proxy so no code to write): docker exec -d vllm-decode sh -c 'cd /vllm-workspace/examples/disaggregated/lmcache/disagg_prefill_lmcache_v1 && nohup python3 disagg_proxy_server.py --host 0.0.0.0 --port 30080 --prefiller-host 127.0.0.1 --prefiller-port 8100 --decoder-host 127.0.0.1 --decoder-port 8200 > /opt/dlami/nvme/pd/proxy.log 2>&1 &'. (The proxy just needs httpx+fastapi+uvicorn+numpy, all present in the vllm image; running it via docker exec in an engine container guarantees the deps. Host loopback is shared because containers use --network host.)

Confirm proxy up: curl -s http://127.0.0.1:30080/v1/... ; note the proxy example does not define /health, so gate on a real smoke request instead (next step) or add a trivial /health probe by curling the prefiller/decoder health directly.

SMOKE TEST end-to-end through the proxy: curl -s http://127.0.0.1:30080/v1/chat/completions -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"model":"dsv4-nvfp4-dspark","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Say hello in one short sentence."}],"max_tokens":32,"stream":false}' must return a valid completion with non-empty content. This proves prefill->NIXL KV transfer->decode->stream works.

TROUBLESHOOTING (record every issue + fix in findings, user explicitly wants live troubleshooting): (a) If NIXL side-channel bind conflicts or handshake hangs, verify the two ports 5600/5601 differ and UCX_TLS includes cuda_ipc; check decoder log for NIXL agent registration / remote-agent metadata exchange. (b) If DSpark speculative + PD produces an error or the KV shapes mismatch across producer/consumer, first retry with speculative decoding DISABLED on BOTH sides (drop --speculative-config) to validate the base PD path, confirm smoke works, THEN re-add DSpark on the decode side only and re-test. Document whether DSpark is compatible with the NIXL PD path on this build. (c) If fp8 KV layout causes a producer/consumer mismatch, capture the exact error; both sides use identical --kv-cache-dtype fp8 so they should match - if not, note it. (d) On OOM at gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 with TP4 (fewer cards per instance than TP8), lower to 0.85/0.80 and record the value that fits. (e) If the proxy 500s, read /opt/dlami/nvme/pd/proxy.log for the traceback (it prints full tracebacks).

Once smoke passes, record final working configuration in findings: which connector (NixlConnector), kv_role assignment, ports, side-channel ports, gpu-memory-utilization used, whether DSpark stayed enabled on decode, and the two engine + proxy statuses.
acceptance_criteria: vllm-prefill (GPUs 0-3, TP4, kv_producer, :8100) and vllm-decode (GPUs 4-7, TP4, kv_consumer, :8200) are both running with /health 200 and gpumem>0 on their assigned cards
The disagg proxy is listening on 127.0.0.1:30080
A smoke /v1/chat/completions through :30080 returns a valid non-empty completion (proves prefill->NIXL->decode end to end)
findings documents the exact working config and every troubleshooting step + resolution (connector choice, DSpark+PD compatibility outcome, fp8 KV cross-instance behavior, gpu-mem-util used)
verification: SSM run: curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:8100/health returns 200 AND :8200/health returns 200
SSM run: nvidia-smi shows nonzero memory.used on all 8 GPUs (both TP4 groups loaded)
SSM run: the smoke chat-completions curl through :30080 returns JSON with a non-empty choices[0].message.content
findings:
OUTCOME: PASS. vLLM NIXL PD 4P4D is live on i-07a1fb189f180ff3e. Both engines /health=200, all 8 GPUs loaded (~246 GB/card), proxy on 127.0.0.1:30080, and an end-to-end smoke chat-completion through the proxy returned a valid 32-token completion (prefill->NIXL KV transfer->decode proven; proxy log even printed 'Prefill node TTFT stats' ~5ms). Leaving vllm-prefill + vllm-decode + proxy RUNNING for FEAT-003 benches.

FINAL WORKING CONFIG:
- Image: vllm/vllm-openai:nightly (vLLM 0.29.1rc1.dev9+g2671fedfc). Model: /opt/dlami/nvme/models/nvidia__DeepSeek-V4-Flash-nvfp4-DSpark, served-model-name dsv4-nvfp4-dspark.
- Connector: NixlConnector (V1). PREFILL = kv_producer on GPUs 0-3 (TP4), port 8100, side-channel VLLM_NIXL_SIDE_CHANNEL_PORT=5600. DECODE = kv_consumer on GPUs 4-7 (TP4), port 8200, side-channel 5601. Side-channel ports MUST differ (5600 vs 5601). NIXL rendezvous kv_port both 14579 on 127.0.0.1 (loopback shared via --network host); handshake succeeded, no bind conflict.
- Shared flags on BOTH sides: --tensor-parallel-size 4 --enable-expert-parallel --trust-remote-code --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 --max-model-len 133120 --reasoning-parser deepseek_v4 --tool-call-parser deepseek_v4 --enable-auto-tool-choice. Env: VLLM_USE_V1=1, HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1, UCX_TLS=cuda_ipc,cuda_copy,tcp. Container: --network host --ipc host --shm-size 32g -v /opt/dlami/nvme:/opt/dlami/nvme -v hfcache:/root/.cache/huggingface.
- DSpark speculative decoding: KEPT ENABLED on BOTH sides via --speculative-config '{"method":"dspark","num_speculative_tokens":7,"draft_sample_method":"greedy"}'. It is compatible with the NIXL PD path on this build - no KV-shape mismatch, no error; the DSpark-drop fallback was NOT needed. (Note on TPOT intent: the decode engine is where DSpark+fp8-KV+NVFP4 do their work for TPOT/ITL; the prefill engine carries an identical config for KV-layout symmetry across producer/consumer.)
- KV cache: 185.45 GiB available per engine, GPU KV cache size 1,908,520 tokens, max concurrency 14.34x for 133120-token requests. Block size 256 (DEEPSEEK_SPARSE_SWA backend), 'Using BLHNC KV cache layout' on both. fp8 KV identical on both sides => producer/consumer layouts matched cleanly.
- gpu-memory-utilization 0.90 fit with headroom on B300 275GB cards (no OOM at TP4); did NOT need to drop to 0.85/0.80.
- Green signals seen on both: NIXL available, DeepSeek V4 expert_dtype=fp4, DeepGemmFp8BlockScaledMMKernel + DeepGEMM E8M0 (UE8M0), TRT-LLM fused MoE cooperative launch (140 SMs MoE / 8 reserved), FlashInfer allreduce (mnnvl) + FlashInfer autotune, DSA/sparse-MLA warmup, breakable CUDA graph, 'Application startup complete' + Uvicorn on 8100/8200. Cold start ~11 min (weight load + TileLang JIT + DeepGEMM/cicc compile + FlashInfer autotune 16384-token buckets + sparse MLA warmup + CUDA graph capture).

TROUBLESHOOTING (issue -> fix):
1. GPU-COLLISION (main issue): First launch used 'docker run --gpus all' + '-e NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0,1,2,3 / 4,5,6,7'. '--gpus all' exposes ALL 8 cards to each container and OVERRIDES NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES, so vLLM TP4 picked logical devices 0-3 in BOTH containers - they collided on physical GPUs 0-3 (2 procs x 52 GB each) while GPUs 4-7 stayed at 4 MiB. Verified via nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps (both engines' PIDs on the same 4 UUIDs) and 'echo NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES' inside the container printing empty. FIX: docker rm -f both, change launch to pin physical cards with --gpus '"device=0,1,2,3"' (prefill) / '"device=4,5,6,7"' (decode) and drop the ineffective NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES env. After relaunch, memory correctly split 0-3 (prefill) vs 4-7 (decode).
2. SSM JSON QUOTING: the --kv-transfer-config / --speculative-config values contain double quotes; passing them inside send-command 'commands=[...]' is fragile. FIX: wrote a driver script /opt/dlami/nvme/pd/launch_pd.sh to the instance (base64-encoded to preserve quoting) that builds the docker run argv as a bash array; relaunches are now one command: 'bash /opt/dlami/nvme/pd/launch_pd.sh prefill|decode' (supports GMU=0.85 and SPEC_ON=0 overrides for the documented fallbacks). Proxy started via /opt/dlami/nvme/pd/start_proxy.sh (docker exec -d vllm-decode).
3. SMOKE 500 (transient, self-inflicted): first smoke used 'printf %s {json...}' inside the SSM array which stripped the double quotes, producing malformed JSON '{model:...}'; proxy logged json.decoder.JSONDecodeError 'Expecting property name enclosed in double quotes'. FIX: base64-encoded the payload to /opt/dlami/nvme/pd/smoke.json and POSTed with --data @file; second request returned 200 with valid content. Proxy itself was fine (it has no /health, gated on the real smoke request as planned).
4. Cold-start exceeds SSM send-command timeout: launched engines with 'docker run -d' (detached) and polled readiness with short SSM commands (docker logs --tail, curl /health, nvidia-smi) instead of a blocking foreground command. The recurring 'No available shared memory broadcast block found in 60 seconds' EngineCore lines during startup are BENIGN (long TileLang/FlashInfer compile), not a hang - confirmed workers at ~100% CPU actively JIT-compiling.

RELAUNCH RECIPE (for FEAT-003 if a restart is needed): bash /opt/dlami/nvme/pd/launch_pd.sh prefill ; bash /opt/dlami/nvme/pd/launch_pd.sh decode ; wait ~11 min for both /health=200 ; docker exec -d vllm-decode bash /opt/dlami/nvme/pd/start_proxy.sh ; bench via 127.0.0.1:30080. Reminder: this nightly rejects --random-range-ratio 1.0 (use 0.0 for fixed 40k input).
